        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        long c1 = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long c2 = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String s = br.readLine();
        int adults = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '1') adults++;
        }
        int pupils = n - adults;
        long minAdult = Math.min(adults, pupils);
        long maxAdult = adults;
        long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (long k = 1; k <= maxAdult; k++) {
            if (k > minAdult + maxAdult) break;
            long minGroups = Math.max(k, (pupils + k + k - 1) / k);
            if (minGroups > k) continue;
            long maxGroups = k + minAdult;
            if (minGroups > maxGroups) continue;
            long minPupils = Math.max(0, pupils - (maxGroups - k) * (k - 1));
            long maxPupils = Math.min(pupils, minGroups * k - k);
            if (minPupils > maxPupils) continue;
            long minTotal = minGroups * k + minPupils;
            long maxTotal = maxGroups * k + maxPupils;
            long minX = minTotal;
            long maxX = maxTotal;
            if (minX > n) continue;
            if (maxX < n) continue;
            long x = Math.max(minX, Math.min(maxX, n));

}
